title: Ioash
summary: Raleigh names Ioash in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Ioash was ouer the store of the oyle of Dauid. He is not Ioash the father of Gideon, not Ioash in Moab, and not Ioash King of Iuda. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVII, §. IX, sig. 300a–300b
